description: Large positive reward for successful landing: both legs contact, upright (|angle|<0.1), on pad (|x|<0.1, y near 0), low speed (|vx|<0.1, |vy|<0.1).
Dense shaping reward for progress: reduction in distance to pad and vertical speed.
Small penalty per unit of main engine power to encourage fuel efficiency.
Large negative reward for crashing or going out of bounds.
Small penalty for large angle or angular velocity to encourage upright posture.
Small bonus when both legs are in contact with ground.
